about_the_game:
The Season 3 Must-Have Pack is equipped with essential items to enhance your journey!

This pack includes a Teleport Stone for swift travel, a Hunting Assist that automatically consumes potions and handles returns to support your hunts, and a Transformation Stick to prevent monsters from making the first strike. With these items, you'll be well-prepared for the adventures ahead in DK Online!

Contents

  • [Season] Sealed Teleport Stone (30 days) / Consumable Item
    - This item allows you to teleport directly to a location on your teleport list or to a specific bookmarked place.

  • [Season] Sealed Hunting Assist (30 days) / Consumable Item

    - This item automatically uses potions and will teleport you back based on your HP.

  • [Season] Sealed Dragon's Stick(30 days) / Consumable Item
    - This item allows you to freely transform.


    ■ Notices

- This DLC contains consumable items and is non-refundable.

- The DLC will be instantly delivered to your DK Shop Inventory.

- Each account can only purchase each DLC once.

- DLC contents will be maintained during season3 (about 10 months)

 * Season 3 started on Dec 24, 2024 (PT/UTC)

- DLC contents are subject to change after prior notice.
